name: Why should I hire a licensed plumber for gas line work instead of a general handyman?

mainEntity.name: Why should I hire a licensed plumber for gas line work instead of a general handyman?

acceptedAnswer.text: Hiring a licensed plumber for gas line work is crucial for safety and compliance. Licensed plumbers have undergone extensive training, possess specific certifications, and are knowledgeable about local gas codes and safety regulations. Gas line installations and repairs are high-risk tasks that, if done incorrectly, can lead to dangerous leaks, fires, or explosions. A general handyman may not have the necessary expertise, tools, or insurance to handle such work safely and legally, potentially jeopardizing your home and family's safety.
acceptedAnswer.description: Licensed plumbers have specific training, certifications, and code knowledge essential for safe and compliant gas line work, unlike general handymen.
